title: Relationships 2.0: When Did Marriage Become So Hard?

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: No matter how many weddings you've been to,
sentences.zh: 无论你参加过多少场婚礼，

sentences.en: it's hard to shake that contagious feeling of optimism.
sentences.zh: 都很难摆脱那种极具感染力的乐观情绪。

sentences.en: Couples pledge to love one another in sickness and in health,
sentences.zh: 新人们誓言无论疾病还是健康，都要彼此相爱，

sentences.en: for richer, for poorer.
sentences.zh: 无论贫穷还是富有。

sentences.en: Family members dab tears from their eyes,
sentences.zh: 家人们擦拭着眼角的泪水，

sentences.en: agreeing that these two people are meant to be together forever.
sentences.zh: 认同这两个人注定要永远在一起。

sentences.en: But so many marriages become unhappy.
sentences.zh: 但许多婚姻最终变得不幸福。

sentences.en: Some dissolve.
sentences.zh: 有些分崩离析。

sentences.en: Some end in divorce.
sentences.zh: 有些以离婚告终。

sentences.en: And even the successful ones are not without challenges.
sentences.zh: 即使是那些美满的婚姻也并非没有挑战。

sentences.en: No one would deny that long-term relationships are hard.
sentences.zh: 没有人会否认长期关系是艰难的。

sentences.en: And in fact, there's evidence, they're getting harder.
sentences.zh: 事实上，有证据表明，它们正变得越来越难。

sentences.en: Over the past few weeks, our Relationships 2.0 series
sentences.zh: 在过去几周里，我们的“关系 2.0”系列节目

sentences.en: has explored new ways to think about how we engage with the people in our lives.
sentences.zh: 探索了关于我们如何与生命中的人相处的新思路。

sentences.en: We've talked about how to build new bonds with others,
sentences.zh: 我们讨论了如何与他人建立新的纽带，

sentences.en: how to strengthen the bonds we already have.
sentences.zh: 以及如何加强我们现有的纽带。

sentences.en: We've looked at how we can respond to conflict
sentences.zh: 我们研究了如何应对冲突，

sentences.en: and how we can work through disagreements more effectively.
sentences.zh: 以及如何更有效地解决分歧。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we turn to our favorite episode about marriage.
sentences.zh: 本周在《隐藏的大脑》节目中，我们将重温我们最喜欢的一期关于婚姻的节目。

sentences.en: We'll take a closer look at the history of this institution
sentences.zh: 我们将深入了解这一制度的历史，

sentences.en: and why our expectations for marriage have changed so much in recent years.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么近年来我们对婚姻的期望发生了如此大的变化。

sentences.en: Lots of people argue that having these high expectations is problematic
sentences.zh: 许多人认为，抱有如此高的期望是有问题的，

sentences.en: and it's harming the institution of marriage.
sentences.zh: 而且这正在损害婚姻制度。

sentences.en: And frankly, among the people who used to argue that is myself.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，曾经持这种观点的人中就包括我自己。

sentences.en: And we'll discuss ways to improve our love lives,
sentences.zh: 我们将讨论改善爱情生活的方法，

sentences.en: sometimes by asking more of our relationships
sentences.zh: 有时是通过对我们的关系提出更多要求，

sentences.en: and sometimes by asking less.
sentences.zh: 而有时则是通过减少要求。

sentences.en: To understand marriage today,
sentences.zh: 为了理解今天的婚姻，

sentences.en: we thought it best to go back to a time and place
sentences.zh: 我们认为最好回到一个时间和地点，

sentences.en: when marriage was very different.
sentences.zh: 那时婚姻是非常不同的。

sentences.en: Well, I've been studying the history of family life for many, many years,
sentences.zh: 我研究家庭生活史已经很多很多年了，

sentences.en: but I specifically got interested in marriage
sentences.zh: 但我特别对婚姻产生兴趣，

sentences.en: as we got into these debates about what traditional marriage was.
sentences.zh: 是因为我们开始讨论什么是传统婚姻。

sentences.en: That's Stephanie Koons.
sentences.zh: 那是斯蒂芬妮·库恩茨。

sentences.en: She's a professor at the Evergreen State College
sentences.zh: 她是常青州立学院的一名教授。

sentences.en: and the author of the book Marriage, A History.
sentences.zh: 以及《婚姻：一部历史》一书的作者。

sentences.en: Stephanie says the earliest marriages had nothing to do
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮说，最早的婚姻与两个人的感情

sentences.en: with the feelings of two people or their attraction to one another.
sentences.zh: 或彼此的吸引力毫无关系。

sentences.en: As you probably know, marriage was much more about economics
sentences.zh: 正如你可能知道的那样，婚姻更多是关于经济利益

sentences.en: and acquiring powerful in-laws.
sentences.zh: 以及获得有权势的姻亲。

sentences.en: Marriage originally arose in more egalitarian band-level societies
sentences.zh: 婚姻最初出现在更平等的部落社会中，

sentences.en: as a way of sharing resources
sentences.zh: 作为一种共享资源的方式，

sentences.en: and establishing peaceful relations with groups
sentences.zh: 并与那些你可能只会偶尔见到、

sentences.en: that you might otherwise only see occasionally
sentences.zh: 且不知道他们会是朋友还是敌人的群体

sentences.en: and you might not know if they were going to be friends or enemies.
sentences.zh: 建立和平关系的方式。

sentences.en: It was a way of circulating obligations and goods.
sentences.zh: 这是一种流通义务和商品的方式。

sentences.en: I marry my child off to you
sentences.zh: 我把我的孩子嫁给你，

sentences.en: and that means you owe me things, but I also owe you things.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你欠我东西，但我同时也欠你东西。

sentences.en: Stephanie brought up a famous example from history,
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮提到了历史上一个著名的例子，

sentences.en: the union between Cleopatra of Egypt and Mark Antony of Rome.
sentences.zh: 埃及艳后克利奥帕特拉与罗马马克·安东尼的结合。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Taylor as Cleopatra, Siren of the Nile.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·泰勒饰演的克利奥帕特拉，尼罗河的妖女。

sentences.en: This is from a 1963 film version.
sentences.zh: 这是1963年电影版中的片段。

sentences.en: Richard Burton as Mark Antony.
sentences.zh: 理查德·伯顿饰演马克·安东尼。

sentences.en: Flash, impetuous leader of once invincible legion.
sentences.zh: 曾经不可战胜的军团中，闪耀而冲动的领袖。

sentences.en: Dreaded adversary on the field of battle.
sentences.zh: 战场上令人畏惧的对手。

sentences.en: The Hollywood version of the story portrays Cleopatra and Antony
sentences.zh: 好莱坞版本的电影将克利奥帕特拉和安东尼

sentences.en: as being very much in love.
sentences.zh: 描绘成深爱彼此的样子。

sentences.en: But Stephanie paints a slightly different picture.
sentences.zh: 但斯蒂芬妮描绘的画面略有不同。

sentences.en: I think that the theme song for that relationship
sentences.zh: 我认为那段关系的主题曲

sentences.en: could have been What's Love Got to Do With It?
sentences.zh: 应该是《与爱何干？》。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: There may have been passion,
sentences.zh: 他们之间可能确实有激情，

sentences.en: but it was more passion for power than sexual,
sentences.zh: 但那更多是对权力的渴望，而非性欲，

sentences.en: although sexual probably entered into it too.
sentences.zh: 尽管性可能也包含在其中。

sentences.en: Cleopatra and Antony's marriage was primarily about strategy.
sentences.zh: 克利奥帕特拉和安东尼的婚姻主要关乎战略。

sentences.en: Rome and Egypt were the two most powerful empires in the world.
sentences.zh: 罗马和埃及是当时世界上最强大的两个帝国。

sentences.en: So getting them, anybody who got them together
sentences.zh: 所以，任何能将他们撮合在一起，

sentences.en: and got an alliance between them would be unstoppable.
sentences.zh: 并促成他们之间结盟的人，都将势不可挡。

sentences.en: The story goes that Cleopatra was married to her brother
sentences.zh: 故事是这样的，克利奥帕特拉嫁给了她的兄弟，

sentences.en: and without getting into all the details,
sentences.zh: 就不细说所有细节了，

sentences.en: let's just say she wasn't too happy with that.
sentences.zh: 只能说她对此并不太高兴。

sentences.en: So she started an affair with Julius Caesar, the ruler of Rome.
sentences.zh: 于是她开始与罗马统治者尤利乌斯·凯撒私通。

sentences.en: Cleopatra became pregnant.
sentences.zh: 克利奥帕特拉怀孕了。

sentences.en: When the baby was born, he was named Caesarian.
sentences.zh: 孩子出生时，取名为凯撒里昂。

sentences.en: The child gave Cleopatra and Caesar a claim to each other's throne.
sentences.zh: 这个孩子让克利奥帕特拉和凯撒都有了争夺对方王位的筹码。

sentences.en: It was something they both desperately wanted.
sentences.zh: 这是他们两人都极度渴望的东西。

sentences.en: Sounds like an episode of Game of Thrones, right?
sentences.zh: 听起来像《权力的游戏》里的情节，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, then Caesar died and Mark Antony came along.
sentences.zh: 后来凯撒去世了，马克·安东尼出现了。

sentences.en: And, of course, the story tells that she seduced him.
sentences.zh: 当然，故事里说她诱惑了他。

sentences.en: But, you know, when you really look at what was happening practically,
sentences.zh: 但你知道，当你真正审视当时实际发生的情况时，

sentences.en: this was another political alliance.
sentences.zh: 这又是另一场政治联姻。

sentences.en: First, as did Caesar, you will marry me according to Egyptian ritual.
sentences.zh: 首先，你要像凯撒一样，按照埃及的仪式娶我。

sentences.en: It's not a condition, that's a reward.
sentences.zh: 这不是条件，这是奖赏。

sentences.en: You will declare by your authority Caesarian to be king of Egypt.
sentences.zh: 你要以你的权威宣布凯撒里昂为埃及国王。

sentences.en: And we will rule together in his name.
sentences.zh: 我们将以他的名义共同统治。

sentences.en: Caesarian was too young to rule, and Antony could rule in his place.
sentences.zh: 凯撒里昂太小无法统治，而安东尼可以代他执政。

sentences.en: So it was a great big political alliance, just like Game of Thrones.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一场宏大的政治联姻，就像《权力的游戏》一样。

sentences.en: This marriage strategy wasn't just for kings and queens.
sentences.zh: 这种婚姻策略并非国王和王后所独有。

sentences.en: There's a common misconception that people of lower classes in this time married for love.
sentences.zh: 有一种常见的误解，认为那个时代的底层人民是因爱结婚的。

sentences.en: Not true, Stephanie says.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬妮说，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: You couldn't run a farm with one person.
sentences.zh: 你不可能一个人经营农场。

sentences.en: You couldn't run a bakery with one person.
sentences.zh: 你也不可能一个人经营面包店。

sentences.en: So people who were bakers married other bakers.
sentences.zh: 所以面包师通常会和另一位面包师结婚。

sentences.en: If you were a peasant, you wanted somebody who had a good reputation as a hard worker.
sentences.zh: 如果你是农民，你会想要一个以勤劳著称的人。

sentences.en: And that was much more important than this frivolous luxury,
sentences.zh: 这比那种轻浮的浪漫要重要得多，

sentences.en: is the way it was really thought of, as how attracted you were to the person.
sentences.zh: 人们当时确实是这样看待的，即你对某人有多大的吸引力。

sentences.en: A different idea started to become more common in the 17 and 1800s.
sentences.zh: 一种不同的观念在17和18世纪开始变得普遍。

sentences.en: Jane Austen, the famous novelist, may well have been the trailblazer.
sentences.zh: 著名小说家简·奥斯汀很可能就是这一潮流的先驱。

sentences.en: For those who don't remember the plot of her book, Pride and Prejudice,
sentences.zh: 对于那些不记得她的小说《傲慢与偏见》情节的人，

sentences.en: Mr. Darcy, who has been promised in marriage to his wealthy cousin, falls instead for Elizabeth
sentences.zh: 达西先生本已许配给富有的表亲，却爱上了伊丽莎白·

sentences.en: Bennett, a woman of modest means.
sentences.zh: 班内特，一位家境平平的女子。

sentences.en: That throws his aunt into a rage.
sentences.zh: 这让他的姨妈勃然大怒。

sentences.en: Mr. Darcy is engaged to my daughter.
sentences.zh: 达西先生已经和我女儿订婚了。

sentences.en: Now what have you to say?
sentences.zh: 你现在还有什么好说的？

sentences.en: Only this, if that is the case, you can have no reason to suppose he would make an offer to me.
sentences.zh: 只有这一点，如果真是那样，你没有任何理由认为他会向我求婚。

sentences.en: You selfish girl!
sentences.zh: 你这个自私的女孩！

sentences.en: This union has been planned since their infancy.
sentences.zh: 这桩婚事在他们幼年时就已定下。

sentences.en: Do you think it can be prevented by a young woman of inferior birth?
sentences.zh: 你以为一个出身卑微的年轻女子就能阻止这一切吗？

sentences.en: Heaven and earth, are the shades of Pemberley to be thus polluted?
sentences.zh: 天哪，彭伯利的门第难道要因此蒙羞吗？

sentences.en: Now tell me once and for all, are you engaged to him?
sentences.zh: 现在给我一个痛快话，你和他订婚了吗？

sentences.en: I am not.
sentences.zh: 我没有。

sentences.en: So, Stephanie, talk about this.
sentences.zh: 那么，斯蒂芬妮，谈谈这个吧。

sentences.en: This is the first glimmers, if you will, of the idea that in some ways love was coming to conquer marriage.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是爱情开始征服婚姻的最初萌芽。

sentences.en: This clip you used is perfect because it illustrates the fact that
sentences.zh: 你用的这段视频非常完美，因为它说明了一个事实：

sentences.en: men found it easier to embrace the love match than women did.
sentences.zh: 男性比女性更容易接受因爱结合的婚姻。

sentences.en: Men could marry down because they could go out and earn wages.
sentences.zh: 男性可以向下通婚，因为他们可以外出赚取工资。

sentences.en: Women had to be very, very cautious.
sentences.zh: 女性则必须非常、非常谨慎。

sentences.en: You know, as you could say, my heart inclines to Harry, but, you know, I'd better marry who my parents want me to
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可以说，我的心倾向于哈里，但是，你知道，我最好还是嫁给父母希望我嫁的人，

sentences.en: and the person who is most likely to be able to support me.
sentences.zh: 以及那个最有可能养活我的人。

sentences.en: And so there was a prolonged period of time where men actually were more romantic than women in the courtship arena.
sentences.zh: 因此，在求爱领域，男性实际上曾有一段时期比女性更浪漫。

sentences.en: By the second half of the 19th century, the Jane Austen model of marriage had taken firm hold in the United States.
sentences.zh: 到了19世纪下半叶，简·奥斯汀式的婚姻模式在美国已根深蒂固。

sentences.en: The idea of marrying for anything other than love came to be seen as old-fashioned.
sentences.zh: 为了爱情以外的任何理由而结婚，被视为过时。

sentences.en: And with the rise of this new idea came another.
sentences.zh: 随着这一新观念的兴起，另一种观念也随之而来。

sentences.en: If marriage was once seen as a partnership between people from similar backgrounds and similar social classes,
sentences.zh: 如果说婚姻曾经被视为背景和社会阶层相似的人之间的伙伴关系，

sentences.en: the new model of marriage began to celebrate the coming together of people
sentences.zh: 那么新的婚姻模式开始推崇那些

sentences.en: who were supposedly radically different from one another.
sentences.zh: 被认为截然不同的人走到一起。

sentences.en: And you got this new theory that love was a union of opposites.
sentences.zh: 于是出现了一种新理论，认为爱情是相反特质的结合。

sentences.en: Now this idea came that men and women were totally different
sentences.zh: 当时流行一种观点，认为男女完全不同，

sentences.en: and you could only have access to the emotions, resources, abilities of the other
sentences.zh: 你只有通过结婚并维持婚姻，

sentences.en: by getting married and staying married.
sentences.zh: 才能获得对方的情感、资源和能力。

sentences.en: You were incomplete without it.
sentences.zh: 没有婚姻，你就是不完整的。

sentences.en: In practice, this dovetailed with a changing economic landscape in the country
sentences.zh: 实际上，这与当时国家不断变化的经济格局相吻合，

sentences.en: where men increasingly became the breadwinners and women became homemakers.
sentences.zh: 男性日益成为养家糊口的人，女性则成为家庭主妇。

sentences.en: The 1950s sitcom Leave it to Beaver makes clear this division between male and female roles.
sentences.zh: 20世纪50年代的情景喜剧《天才老爸》（Leave it to Beaver）清楚地展示了这种男女角色的分工。

sentences.en: Whenever we cook inside, mom always does it cooking.
sentences.zh: 每当我们在室内做饭时，总是妈妈在做。

sentences.en: But whenever we cook outside, you always do it.
sentences.zh: 但每当我们在户外做饭时，总是你来做。

sentences.en: How come?
sentences.zh: 这是为什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's sort of traditional, I guess.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想这算是一种传统吧。

sentences.en: You know, they say a woman's place is in the home
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们常说女性的归宿在家庭，

sentences.en: and I suppose as long as she's in the home, she might as well be in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我想只要她在家里，她最好还是待在厨房里。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: Well, that explains about mom.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那解释了关于妈妈的事。

sentences.en: But how come you always do the outside cooking?
sentences.zh: 但为什么户外烹饪总是你来做呢？

sentences.en: Well, I'll tell you, son.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我告诉你吧，儿子。

sentences.en: Women do all right when they have all the modern conveniences.
sentences.zh: 女性在拥有所有现代便利设施时表现得很好。

sentences.en: But us men are better at this rugged type of outdoor cooking.
sentences.zh: 但我们男人更擅长这种粗犷的户外烹饪。

sentences.en: Sort of a throwback to caveman days.
sentences.zh: 算是回到了穴居人时代吧。

sentences.en: Talk to me about this idea, Stephanie.
sentences.zh: 跟我谈谈这个想法，斯蒂芬妮。

sentences.en: So clearly gender biases played a role in how we came to think about marriage.
sentences.zh: 很显然，性别偏见在我们对婚姻的思考方式中起了一定作用。

sentences.en: Well, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 嗯，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: But what's interesting about this clip is that the concept of the male breadwinner
sentences.zh: 但这段视频有趣的地方在于，“男性养家糊口”这个概念

sentences.en: was unknown before the 19th century.
sentences.zh: 在19世纪之前是闻所未闻的。

sentences.en: Women worked in the home, but so did men.
sentences.zh: 女性在家里干活，男性也一样。

sentences.en: And men didn't go out and bring home the bacon.
sentences.zh: 男人并不是出门去赚取面包。

sentences.en: Women helped raise the pig.
sentences.zh: 女性也会帮忙养猪。

sentences.en: Maybe the man butchered it.
sentences.zh: 也许是男人负责宰杀。

sentences.en: But the woman often cured the bacon and took the bacon to market.
sentences.zh: 但通常是女性负责腌制培根并拿到集市上去卖。

sentences.en: So, again, this was part of this new idea of love that I talked about earlier, the idea
sentences.zh: 所以，这再次印证了我之前提到的那种关于爱的新观念，即

sentences.en: that men and women were so different that the man had to do all the outside stuff because
sentences.zh: 男女差异巨大，男人必须负责所有外部事务，因为

sentences.en: the woman couldn't do it, and the woman had to do all the inside stuff because the man
sentences.zh: 女人做不了，而女人必须负责所有内部事务，因为男人

sentences.en: couldn't do it and wasn't supposed to do it.
sentences.zh: 做不了，也不应该做。

sentences.en: The idea of the love match may have been controversial at first, but when concerns were raised about
sentences.zh: “因爱结合”的理念起初可能存在争议，但当人们开始担心

sentences.en: how people from different backgrounds would stay together when they didn't have the bond

sentences.zh: 在她那场著名的TED演讲中，她总结了其中的一些挑战。

sentences.en: And I want to play you a short clip.
sentences.zh: 我想给你们播放一小段视频。

sentences.en: So we come to one person, and we basically are asking them to give us what once an entire
sentences.zh: 我们走进一段关系，基本上是要求对方提供曾经由整个

sentences.en: village used to provide.
sentences.zh: 村庄所提供的支持。

sentences.en: Give me belonging.
sentences.zh: 给我归属感。

sentences.en: Give me identity.
sentences.zh: 给我认同感。

sentences.en: Give me continuity.
sentences.zh: 给我延续感。

sentences.en: But give me transcendence and mystery and awe, all in one.
sentences.zh: 但同时又要给我超越感、神秘感和敬畏感，所有这些都要集于一身。

sentences.en: Give me comfort.
sentences.zh: 给我舒适感。

sentences.en: Give me edge.
sentences.zh: 给我刺激感。

sentences.en: Give me novelty.
sentences.zh: 给我新鲜感。

sentences.en: Give me familiarity.
sentences.zh: 给我熟悉感。

sentences.en: Give me predictability.
sentences.zh: 给我可预测性。

sentences.en: Give me surprise.
sentences.zh: 给我惊喜。

sentences.en: And we think it's a given, and toys and lingerie are going to save us with that.
sentences.zh: 我们认为这是理所当然的，觉得玩具和内衣就能拯救这一切。

sentences.en: So I love that passage, Eli, but you talk about the same idea in your book.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这段话，伊莱（Eli），但你在书中也谈到了同样的观点。

sentences.en: You give the analogy of a woman who once turned to five different friends for important things
sentences.zh: 你举了一个例子，说一位女性曾经向五个不同的朋友寻求她所需要的

sentences.en: she needed, but once she gets married, she turns to her husband for those same five things,
sentences.zh: 重要支持，但一旦结婚，她就转而向丈夫寻求这五样东西，

sentences.en: and he's not able to provide all of them, and she feels now unfulfilled.
sentences.zh: 而他无法全部提供，于是她现在感到未被满足。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In the research literature on how we achieve our goals, there's a clunky word called multifinality,
sentences.zh: 在关于我们如何实现目标的学术文献中，有一个拗口的词叫“多重目标性”（multifinality），

sentences.en: and this is the idea that a given means can serve multiple goals.
sentences.zh: 这个概念是指某种特定的手段可以服务于多个目标。

sentences.en: So, for example, when I walk to work, that might simultaneously meet my need to get to work,
sentences.zh: 例如，当我步行去上班时，这可能同时满足了我去上班的需求，

sentences.en: but also my needs to get some fresh air and get some exercise.
sentences.zh: 也满足了我呼吸新鲜空气和锻炼身体的需求。

sentences.en: And so this one activity can serve all sorts of functions.
sentences.zh: 所以，这一项活动可以发挥各种各样的功能。

sentences.en: What's interesting is that's really what we've done to marriage, right, is that marriage for
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，这正是我们对婚姻所做的事情，对吧？婚姻在

sentences.en: a long time served a set and relatively limited array of different functions for us.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里，为我们提供了一套相对有限的不同功能。

sentences.en: And over time, we've piled more and more of these emotional and psychological functions.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，我们堆积了越来越多这类情感和心理功能。

sentences.en: So instead of turning to our close friends and other relatives for nights out on the town,
sentences.zh: 所以，我们不再向亲密朋友和其他亲戚寻求夜间外出娱乐，

sentences.en: for deep, intimate disclosure, to a larger and larger extent, our spouse has replaced
sentences.zh: 不再寻求深度的亲密倾诉，而在越来越大的程度上，我们的配偶取代了

sentences.en: a lot of what we used to look to our broader social network to help us do.
sentences.zh: 我们过去寻求更广泛的社交网络来帮助我们完成的许多事情。

sentences.en: You know, as I read your book, Eli, I realized that it's not just what we expect from our
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我读你的书时，伊莱，我意识到改变的不仅仅是我们对

sentences.en: partners that's changing.
sentences.zh: 伴侣的期望。

sentences.en: We also now expect that we can unlock special things in our partners.
sentences.zh: 我们现在还期望能够发掘出伴侣身上特别的东西。

sentences.en: And this is also reflected in the movies.
sentences.zh: 这一点也反映在电影中。

sentences.en: The 1997 movie, As Good As It Gets, has a scene where a woman who is fed up with, you know,
sentences.zh: 1997年的电影《尽善尽美》（As Good As It Gets）中有一个场景，一位女性受够了

sentences.en: put downs by her, by the man who's trying to woo her, demands that he give her a compliment.
sentences.zh: 那个试图追求她的男人的贬低，要求他夸奖她一下。

sentences.en: Okay, here I go.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我要说了。

sentences.en: Clearly a mistake.
sentences.zh: 显然是个错误。

sentences.en: I've got this, what, ailment?
sentences.zh: 我有这个，什么，毛病？

sentences.en: My doctor, a shrink that I used to go to all the time, he says that in 50 or 60 percent
sentences.zh: 我的医生，我以前常去看的一个心理医生，他说在50%或60%的

sentences.en: of the cases, a pill really helps.
sentences.zh: 病例中，吃药确实有帮助。

sentences.en: I hate pills.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌吃药。

sentences.en: My compliment is, that night when you came over and told me that you would never have...
sentences.zh: 我的夸奖是，那天晚上你过来告诉我，你永远不会……

sentences.en: Um...
Um, all right, well, you were there, you know what you said.
sentences.zh: 嗯，好吧，你在场，你知道你说了什么。

sentences.en: Well, my compliment to you is,
sentences.zh: 好吧，我对你的夸奖是，

sentences.en: the next morning, I started taking the pills.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，我开始吃药了。

sentences.en: I don't quite get how that's a compliment for me.
sentences.zh: 我不太明白这怎么能算是对我的夸奖。

sentences.en: You make me want to be a better man.
sentences.zh: 你让我想要成为一个更好的男人。

sentences.en: That's maybe the best compliment of my life.
sentences.zh: 那可能是我一生中得到的最好的夸奖。

sentences.en: I found this so revealing in the context of your book, Eli.
sentences.zh: 在你的书的语境下，我发现这非常有启发性，伊莱。

sentences.en: Helen Hunt's character is telling Jack Nicholson's character that the thing that makes her feel
sentences.zh: 海伦·亨特（Helen Hunt）饰演的角色告诉杰克·尼科尔森（Jack Nicholson）饰演的角色，让她感到

sentences.en: really good is not what he does for her, but what she can do to unlock something special in him.
sentences.zh: 非常好的不是他为她做了什么，而是她能做什么来激发他身上特别的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah, he is smitten with her, and his desire for her, his being impressed with her and the desire to
sentences.zh: 是的，他被她迷住了，他对她的渴望，他对她的钦佩，以及想要

sentences.en: make her like him more, actually makes him want to grow into a better person.
sentences.zh: 让她更喜欢他的愿望，实际上让他想要成长为一个更好的人。

sentences.en: And in some sense, that's the absolute archetype of what we see in contemporary marriage.
sentences.zh: 在某种意义上，这就是我们在当代婚姻中所见到的绝对原型。

sentences.en: Today, we're looking for our spouse to bring out the ideal version of us,
sentences.zh: 今天，我们期待配偶能带出我们理想中的版本，

sentences.en: the latent version that's inside of us that we can hopefully grow into with enough time and effort.
sentences.zh: 那个潜藏在我们内心深处，我们希望通过足够的时间和努力能够成长成的版本。

sentences.en: You have a wonderful term in your book.
sentences.zh: 你的书中有一个很棒的术语。

sentences.en: You call this the Michelangelo effect.
sentences.zh: 你称之为“米开朗基罗效应”。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is a term I actually got from my doctoral advisor, Carol Ruspolt.
sentences.zh: 是的，这个词其实是我从我的博士导师卡罗尔·鲁斯波特（Carol Rusbult）那里学来的。

sentences.en: Many of your listeners will know that Michelangelo, when he talked about the sculpting process,
sentences.zh: 很多听众都知道，米开朗基罗在谈论雕塑过程时，

sentences.en: talked not in terms of revealing a sculpture,
sentences.zh: 谈论的不是揭示一座雕塑，

sentences.en: but in terms of unleashing it from the rock in which it's been slumbering.
sentences.zh: 而是谈论如何将其从沉睡的岩石中释放出来。

sentences.en: So the sculptor's job is not to create something new, but merely to refine and buff and polish
sentences.zh: 所以雕塑家的工作不是创造新东西，而仅仅是精炼、打磨和抛光，

sentences.en: and maybe scrape away the rough edges of what was already nesting within the rock.
sentences.zh: 或许是刮掉那些原本就嵌套在岩石里的粗糙边缘。

sentences.en: That's a really good metaphor for how partners today try to relate to each other.
sentences.zh: 对于当今伴侣如何尝试相处，这是一个非常好的隐喻。

sentences.en: That is, all of us have an actual self, the person that we currently are,
sentences.zh: 也就是说，我们每个人都有一个现实自我，即我们现在的样子，

sentences.en: but we also have an ideal self, a version of ourselves that's aspirational.
sentences.zh: 但我们也有一个理想自我，一个我们渴望成为的版本。

sentences.en: Like, what could I maybe become if I could be the best version of myself?
sentences.zh: 比如，如果我能成为最好的自己，我可能会变成什么样？

sentences.en: And we look to our partners to be our sculptors,
sentences.zh: 我们期待伴侣成为我们的雕塑家，

sentences.en: to help us until we actually grow toward the best ideal version of ourselves.
sentences.zh: 帮助我们，直到我们真正向着自己最好的理想版本成长。

sentences.en: So Eli, do we actually have this power, this power to play sculptor and bring out the best in someone else?
sentences.zh: 那么伊莱，我们真的有这种力量吗？这种扮演雕塑家并激发他人最好一面的力量？

sentences.en: The answer is yes.
sentences.zh: 答案是肯定的。

sentences.en: We do have this power, but it's not easy to do and not everybody is compatible.
sentences.zh: 我们确实有这种力量，但这并不容易，而且并非每个人都兼容。

sentences.en: And sometimes the version of you that you want to grow into isn't the version of you that I want you to grow into.
sentences.zh: 有时你想成长成的版本，并不是我希望你成长成的版本。

sentences.en: And this is a very delicate dance that we play.
sentences.zh: 这是一场我们共同参与的非常微妙的舞蹈。

sentences.en: And, you know, the best relationships today, the sorts of relationships that I call the all relationships
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当今最好的关系，也就是我所说的“全有”关系，

sentences.en: and the idea of the all or nothing marriage, they're well aligned in this sense.
sentences.zh: 以及“全有或全无”婚姻的理念，在这个意义上是高度一致的。

sentences.en: They're able to bring out the best in each other and connect in a way that facilitates each other's personal growth
sentences.zh: 他们能够激发彼此最好的一面，并以一种促进彼此个人成长的方式建立联系，

sentences.en: and therefore helps to produce a really profound amount of emotional connection and psychological fulfillment.
sentences.zh: 从而有助于产生极其深厚的情感连接和心理满足感。

sentences.en: You know, many marriage experts say that high expectations are the enemy of happiness in marriage.
sentences.zh: 你知道，许多婚姻专家说，高期望是婚姻幸福的敌人。

sentences.en: You come to a slightly different conclusion.
sentences.zh: 你得出了一个略有不同的结论。

sentences.en: You say that it's true that on average, many marriages might be unhappier today than they were half a century ago,
sentences.zh: 你说，平均而言，今天的许多婚姻可能确实比半个世纪前更不幸福，

sentences.en: but that isn't true of all marriages.
sentences.zh: 但这并不适用于所有婚姻。

sentences.en: Who are the exceptions?
sentences.zh: 谁是例外？

sentences.en: The exceptions are people who bring those expectations and are able to meet them.
sentences.zh: 例外是那些怀揣这些期望并能够满足它们的人。

sentences.en: And this is, I think, the crux of the entire issue.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这就是整个问题的症结所在。

sentences.en: Lots of people argue that having these high expectations is problematic and it's harming the institution of marriage.
sentences.zh: 很多人认为，拥有这些高期望是有问题的，并且正在损害婚姻制度。

sentences.en: And frankly, among the people who used to argue that is myself.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，在过去持这种观点的人中，也包括我自己。

sentences.en: I, when I set out to write this book, thought I was writing a book about the decline over time in marriage
sentences.zh: 我，当我着手写这本书时，以为我写的是关于婚姻随时间衰落的书，

sentences.en: and how we're throwing more and more expectations on this one institution and this one relationship,
sentences.zh: 以及我们如何将越来越多的期望压在这个单一的制度和单一的关系上，

sentences.en: but we're not investing enough time and therefore we've really created a seriously problematic approach to marriage.
sentences.zh: 但我们投入的时间不够，因此我们确实创造了一种非常严重的婚姻问题。

sentences.en: And it wasn't until I reviewed these other scientific literatures and learned more about how things have changed
sentences.zh: 直到我回顾了这些其他的科学文献，并更多地了解了事情是如何变化的，

sentences.en: that I realized that's really half the story.
sentences.zh: 我才意识到这其实只是一半的事实。

sentences.en: It is true that we are asking a lot more, especially when it comes to these more psychological and love-based needs than we did in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我们确实要求得更多，特别是在这些心理和基于爱的需求方面，比过去更多。

sentences.en: But some marriages are able to meet those needs.
sentences.zh: 但有些婚姻确实能够满足这些需求。

sentences.en: And so what does it mean if you have a marriage that you're looking for to meet these very highest level needs,
sentences.zh: 那么，如果你拥有一段你期望满足这些最高层次需求的婚姻，

sentences.en: say, for example, in Maslow's hierarchy, and the marriage succeeds in doing so?
sentences.zh: 比如马斯洛需求层次理论中的需求，而婚姻又成功做到了这一点，这意味着什么？

sentences.en: You're able to achieve a level of fulfillment in the marriage that would have been out of reach
sentences.zh: 你能够在婚姻中达到一种满足感，这在那个我们甚至没有尝试去满足这些需求

sentences.en: in an era where we really weren't even trying to meet those types of needs.
sentences.zh: 的时代是遥不可及的。

sentences.en: So at the same time that these high expectations are weighting us down and making it more difficult to achieve a healthy marriage,
sentences.zh: 所以，当这些高期望压得我们喘不过气，使我们更难实现健康的婚姻时，

sentences.en: at the same time that a marriage that would have been acceptable to us in 1950 is a disappointment to us today
sentences.zh: 同时，一段在1950年本可以让我们接受的婚姻，在今天却让我们感到失望，

sentences.en: because of these high expectations,
sentences.zh: 正是因为这些高期望，

sentences.en: those same expectations have placed within reach a level of marital fulfillment that was out of reach until pretty recently.
sentences.zh: 这些同样的期望也让我们触及到了直到最近才遥不可及的婚姻满足感水平。

sentences.en: So this idea that some people invest heavily in their marriages at the expense of careers and friends,
sentences.zh: 所以，有些人以牺牲事业和朋友为代价，甚至可能以牺牲

sentences.en: maybe even, you know, their children's activities,
sentences.zh: 孩子的活动为代价，在婚姻上投入大量精力，

sentences.en: you say this is perfectly captured in a scene from another movie.
sentences.zh: 你说这在另一部电影的场景中得到了完美的体现。

sentences.en: In Sideways, Paul Jamadi's wine connoisseur character explains to his love interest
sentences.zh: 在《杯酒人生》（Sideways）中，保罗·吉亚玛提（Paul Giamatti）饰演的葡萄酒鉴赏家向他的心仪对象

sentences.en: the difference between a Pinot and a Cabernet.
sentences.zh: 解释了黑皮诺（Pinot）和赤霞珠（Cabernet）的区别。

sentences.en: Why are you so into Pinot?
sentences.zh: 你为什么这么迷恋黑皮诺？

sentences.en: I mean, it's like a thing with you.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这好像成了你的执念。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It's a hard grape to grow, as you know, right?
sentences.zh: 这是一种很难种植的葡萄，你知道的，对吧？

sentences.en: It's thin-skinned temperamental, ripens early.
sentences.zh: 它皮薄、喜怒无常，成熟得早。

sentences.en: It's, you know, it's not a survivor like Cabernet,
sentences.zh: 它，你知道，它不像赤霞珠那样是个幸存者，

sentences.en: which can just grow anywhere and thrive even when it's neglected.
sentences.zh: 赤霞珠可以在任何地方生长，即使被忽视也能茁壮成长。

sentences.en: No, Pinot needs constant care and attention.
sentences.zh: 不，黑皮诺需要持续的照料和关注。

sentences.en: You know, and in fact, it can only grow in these really specific little tucked away corners of the world.
sentences.zh: 你知道，事实上，它只能在世界上这些非常具体、隐蔽的角落里生长。

sentences.en: Only the most patient and nurturing of growers can do it, really.
sentences.zh: 真的，只有最有耐心和最善于培育的人才能做到。

sentences.en: Only somebody who really takes the time to understand Pinot's potential
sentences.zh: 只有真正花时间去理解黑皮诺潜力的人，

sentences.en: can then coax it into its fullest expression.
sentences.zh: 才能引导它展现出最充分的表现。

sentences.en: Beavers, they're just the most haunting and brilliant and thrilling and subtle and ancient on the planet.
sentences.zh: 它们是地球上最令人难忘、最辉煌、最惊心动魄、最微妙且古老的。

sentences.en: So, of course, Eli, when we hear this and we're thinking about this in the context of marriage,
sentences.zh: 所以，当然了，伊莱，当我们听到这些并将其放在婚姻的语境下思考时，

sentences.en: why wouldn't we all want to grow Pinot?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们不都想种植黑皮诺呢？

sentences.en: Well, I think a lot of us should be pretty careful about Pinot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为我们很多人在对待黑皮诺时应该非常小心。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that clip does an absolutely masterful job of providing an analogy
sentences.zh: 我是说，我认为那段视频在提供类比方面做得非常出色，

sentences.en: to how marriage has changed in America in the last, say, 50 years or more.
sentences.zh: 类比了过去50年或更长时间里美国婚姻的变化。

sentences.en: It's changed from an institution approximating Cabernet,
sentences.zh: 它已经从一种类似于赤霞珠的制度，

sentences.en: which can just grow anywhere and thrive even when it's neglected,
sentences.zh: 即那种可以在任何地方生长、即使被忽视也能茁壮成长的制度，

sentences.en: to a much more delicate, fragile institution that requires a lot of tending and maintenance.
sentences.zh: 变成了一种需要大量照料和维护的、更加精致脆弱的制度。

sentences.en: So you ask me, who would ever want anything other than Pinot Noir,
sentences.zh: 所以你问我，谁会想要黑皮诺以外的东西呢，

sentences.en: at least according to how Miles thinks about those grapes?
sentences.zh: 至少按照迈尔斯（Miles）对那些葡萄的看法？

sentences.en: And I would say a whole lot of people might not want to deal with something that fragile and delicate.
sentences.zh: 我会说，很多人可能不想处理那种脆弱而精致的东西。

sentences.en: But, like he says, those of us who get it right, that is, well, and he's talking about the grapes,
sentences.zh: 但是，正如他所说，我们这些做对的人，也就是说，嗯，他是在谈论葡萄，

sentences.en: when there's the right grower and the right context, the flavors are just haunting and brilliant and subtle and ancient.
sentences.zh: 当有合适的种植者和合适的背景时，那种风味简直令人难忘、辉煌、微妙且古老。

sentences.en: And what I think he's saying is, this is a high-maintenance grape.
sentences.zh: 我认为他想说的是，这是一种需要高维护的葡萄。

sentences.en: It takes a lot of work.
sentences.zh: 它需要付出很多努力。

sentences.en: And if you aren't careful and attentive, you're going to be disappointed in it.
sentences.zh: 如果你不小心和专注，你就会对它感到失望。

sentences.en: It's going to fail you.
sentences.zh: 它会让你失败。

sentences.en: But if you work hard enough, you can have something truly exquisite.
sentences.zh: 但如果你足够努力，你就能得到真正精致的东西。

sentences.en: And that is where we are today with the all-or-nothing marriage.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们今天所处的“全有或全无”婚姻的现状。

sentences.en: One of the conclusions of your book is that we have, in some ways, two major alternatives
sentences.zh: 你书中的结论之一是，在某种程度上，我们有两个主要的替代方案，

sentences.en: when it comes to dealing with this challenge that many of us want to be at the top of Mount Maslow
sentences.zh: 当我们面对这个挑战时，我们许多人想要登上马斯洛山顶，

sentences.en: but are not investing the time and effort or the patience to actually get there.
sentences.zh: 却又不投入时间、精力或耐心去真正实现它。

sentences.en: In your own marriage, you describe a trip to Seattle where, in your own analogy,
sentences.zh: 在你自己的婚姻中，你描述了一次西雅图之旅，在你自己的类比中，

sentences.en: you found yourself starved of oxygen.
sentences.zh: 你感到自己缺氧了。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We went through a hard time.
sentences.zh: 我们经历了一段艰难的时期。

sentences.en: I, in particular, went through a hard time with the adjustment to parenthood.
sentences.zh: 尤其是对我而言，在适应为人父母的过程中，我经历了一段艰难的时期。

sentences.en: And I, frankly, I think that the reason I had a hard time is the sort of stuff that I'm talking about in the book.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我认为我之所以感到艰难，正是因为我在书中提到的那些问题。

sentences.en: I hadn't sufficiently calibrated or recalibrated my expectations to what life would be like with a newborn.
sentences.zh: 我没有充分地调整或重新调整我的期望，以适应有了新生儿后的生活。

sentences.en: And the research on this is, in fact, tricky.
sentences.zh: 事实上，关于这方面的研究很棘手。

sentences.en: Obviously, having a bundle of joy is a wonderful thing.
sentences.zh: 显然，拥有一个爱情结晶是一件美妙的事情。

sentences.en: And you love the new baby like crazy.
sentences.zh: 你会疯狂地爱上这个新生命。

sentences.en: And kissing that little fuzzy head is one of the most satisfying things we ever get to do in our lives.
sentences.zh: 亲吻那个毛茸茸的小脑袋，是我们一生中最令人满足的事情之一。

sentences.en: But the reality is a recent estimate suggests that it's about 33 and a half additional hours a week of extra time, like of care that goes into that.
sentences.zh: 但现实是，最近的一项估计表明，这每周需要额外投入大约33个半小时的照顾时间。

sentences.en: And I would ask the couples out there listening who don't have a kid, where would those 33.5 hours a week come from?
sentences.zh: 我想问问那些正在收听节目的、还没有孩子的伴侣们，这每周33.5小时的时间从哪里来？

sentences.en: And then you're complementing that with some sleep deprivation and, frankly, much less time for emotional connection or sexual connection with your spouse.
sentences.zh: 再加上睡眠不足，坦白说，你与配偶之间进行情感交流或性生活的时间也大大减少了。

sentences.en: And is it any surprise that the research evidence shows that the arrival of the first baby tends to be pretty hard on the quality of the relationship, on the marital satisfaction,
sentences.zh: 那么，研究证据显示第一个孩子的到来往往会严重影响关系质量和婚姻满意度，

sentences.en: for example?
sentences.zh: 这难道令人惊讶吗？

sentences.en: And it was during that period where we took a trip to Seattle to see my closest and longest term friend,
sentences.zh: 正是在那段时间里，我们去西雅图看望了我最亲密、交往时间最长的朋友，

sentences.en: one of these life experiences that has always been a source of bliss and joy for me throughout the 30-some-odd years of my life at the time.
sentences.zh: 那是我当时三十多年人生中，一直给我带来幸福和快乐的生活体验之一。

sentences.en: And I was miserable.
sentences.zh: 但我却感到非常痛苦。

sentences.en: It turns out that traveling across the country with an eight-month-old is not anything like traveling across the country without an eight-month-old.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，带着一个八个月大的孩子横跨全国旅行，和不带孩子旅行完全是两码事。

sentences.en: And then you're together with your best friend, and there's all the stuff that you used to do.
sentences.zh: 你和最好的朋友在一起，做着你们过去常做的一切事情。

sentences.en: But now there's an eight-month-old there, and you're not doing any of those things.
sentences.zh: 但现在多了一个八个月大的孩子，你什么都做不了了。

sentences.en: And I really had a hard time.
sentences.zh: 我真的度过了一段艰难的时光。

sentences.en: I mean, I can't really exaggerate this.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我真的无法夸大这种感受。

sentences.en: I really struggled emotionally with the adjustment.
sentences.zh: 我在适应过程中确实在情感上挣扎了很久。

sentences.en: And I said to my wife, and I regret saying this.
sentences.zh: 我对妻子说了那样的话，我很后悔。

sentences.en: It's hard for me to say out loud right now.
sentences.zh: 现在要我大声说出来都很困难。

sentences.en: You know, I can endure this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我可以忍受这一切。

sentences.en: Like, I can get past this, and I certainly love my daughter.
sentences.zh: 我可以熬过去，而且我当然爱我的女儿。

sentences.en: But I need to stop trying to have fun because if I'm trying to enjoy my life and I'm trying to enjoy you, I keep end up disappointed.
sentences.zh: 但我需要停止尝试去寻找乐趣，因为如果我试图享受生活，试图享受与你的时光，我最终总是会感到失望。

sentences.en: And she was very upset about that.
sentences.zh: 她对此感到非常难过。

sentences.en: And, you know, I made her cry.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我让她哭了。

sentences.en: I'm not proud of this at all.
sentences.zh: 我一点也不以此为荣。

sentences.en: But she cried and thought, what, is this the end of us trying to live a good life together?
sentences.zh: 但她哭了，心想，难道我们共同追求美好生活的日子就这样结束了吗？

sentences.en: Are we just going to hunker down and be unhappy together?
sentences.zh: 难道我们就要这样凑合着过，一起不快乐吗？

sentences.en: But the truth is this ended up being the lowest point, but also the starting of where I started to recover a little bit.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，这最终成了我的最低谷，但也成了我开始有所好转的起点。

sentences.en: It took that moment before I started to get serious about making life better again.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻之后，我才开始认真考虑如何让生活重新好起来。

sentences.en: And one of the major ways I did it was by recalibrating my expectations, yes, but also reinvesting in a way that made sure that I was more connected to my wife than we had been.
sentences.zh: 我采取的主要方式之一，不仅是重新调整我的期望，还包括以一种确保我与妻子联系比以往更紧密的方式进行投入。

sentences.en: And it took some work, and it did require that we lower expectations in some ways and then try to meet those lowered expectations.
sentences.zh: 这需要付出努力，确实要求我们在某些方面降低期望，然后努力去满足那些降低后的期望。

sentences.en: And we were, in fact, able to do it, but it certainly wasn't easy.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们做到了，但这绝对不容易。

sentences.en: Eli and other researchers have found that it's not especially easy to fulfill a partner's emotional and psychological needs when you're struggling to pay the bills or working three jobs.
sentences.zh: 伊莱和其他研究人员发现，当你还在为生计发愁或身兼三职时，想要满足伴侣的情感和心理需求并非易事。

sentences.en: This might be one reason that the institution of marriage appears to be especially fragile among low-income couples.
sentences.zh: 这可能是低收入伴侣中婚姻制度显得尤为脆弱的原因之一。

sentences.en: When we come back, we're going to look at tangible solutions.
sentences.zh: 稍后回来，我们将探讨切实可行的解决方案。

sentences.en: If you can't afford to take your partner on that romantic trip to Paris, but you still want to get to the top of Mount Maslow, we'll show you how to get there.
sentences.zh: 如果你负担不起带伴侣去巴黎的浪漫之旅，但仍想攀登“马斯洛山”的顶峰，我们会告诉你如何实现。

sentences.en: You're listening to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 你正在收听的是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: I'm Shankar Vedantam.
sentences.zh: 我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: On today's show...
sentences.zh: 在今天的节目中……

sentences.en: Marriage is what brings us together today.
sentences.zh: 婚姻是今天将我们联系在一起的主题。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Marriage.
sentences.zh: 婚姻。

sentences.en: Marriage, that blessed arrangement, that dream within a dream.
sentences.zh: 婚姻，那种神圣的安排，梦中之梦。

sentences.en: The priest from that iconic scene in The Princess Bride describes it beSt.
sentences.zh: 《公主新娘》中那个标志性场景里的牧师描述得最好。

sentences.en: Or does he?
sentences.zh: 真的是这样吗？

sentences.en: We're taking a look at how marriage has evolved over time from a partnership of necessity
sentences.zh: 我们正在审视婚姻是如何随着时间的推移而演变的，从一种基于必要的伙伴关系，

sentences.en: to a union of two very different people who need one another's love to be complete
sentences.zh: 演变为两个截然不同的人为了完整而需要彼此之爱的结合，

sentences.en: to the all-or-nothing relationships identified by psychologist Eli Finkel.
sentences.zh: 再到心理学家伊莱·芬克尔所定义的“全有或全无”的关系。

sentences.en: Eli argues that our expectations for marriage, both gay and straight, among rich and poor, have dramatically increased.
sentences.zh: 伊莱认为，无论是同性还是异性，无论贫富，我们对婚姻的期望都已大幅提高。

sentences.en: Couples who are able to meet these higher expectations are happier than couples have ever been.
sentences.zh: 能够满足这些更高期望的伴侣比以往任何时候都更幸福。

sentences.en: But couples who fall short are unhappier than their counterparts a century ago.
sentences.zh: 但未能达到期望的伴侣则比一个世纪前的同类人更不幸福。

sentences.en: Eli says there are things we can do, what he calls love hacks, to reorient how we think about marriage
sentences.zh: 伊莱说，我们可以做一些他称之为“爱情黑客”的事情，来重新定位我们对婚姻的看法，

sentences.en: and make ourselves more fulfilled in long-term relationships.
sentences.zh: 并使我们在长期关系中感到更加满足。

sentences.en: Some of your listeners might be fans of Marcel Proust, who argues that mystery is not about traveling to new places,
sentences.zh: 你们的一些听众可能是马塞尔·普鲁斯特的粉丝，他认为神秘感不在于前往新的地方，

sentences.en: but about looking with new eyes.
sentences.zh: 而在于用新的眼光去观察。

sentences.en: And the love hacks are exactly that.
sentences.zh: 而这些“爱情黑客”正是如此。

sentences.en: There are ways that we can try to experience the same relationship,
sentences.zh: 我们可以通过一些方法来尝试体验同样的关系，

sentences.en: but view it in a different way and therefore be a little bit happier in the relationship itself.
sentences.zh: 但以不同的方式看待它，从而在关系本身中获得一点点幸福。

sentences.en: So psychologists have long talked about something called the fundamental attribution error,
sentences.zh: 心理学家长期以来一直在讨论一种叫做“基本归因错误”的概念，

sentences.en: which is sometimes when we see someone behave in a way that we don't like,
sentences.zh: 有时当我们看到某人的行为方式是我们不喜欢的，

sentences.en: there's two ways to interpret it.
sentences.zh: 有两种解释方式。

sentences.en: You can either say this person is behaving badly because they're a bad person,
sentences.zh: 你可以说这个人表现不好是因为他是个坏人，

sentences.en: or you can say this person is behaving badly because there's something in the context,
sentences.zh: 或者你可以说这个人表现不好是因为环境中有某种因素，

sentences.en: there's something happening around him or her that's causing him or her to behave this way.
sentences.zh: 是因为他或她周围发生了某些事情导致他或她有这种表现。

sentences.en: And one of the hacks that you suggest is to reinterpret negative behavior from your partner
sentences.zh: 你建议的其中一个“黑客”技巧就是重新解读伴侣的负面行为，

sentences.en: in a way that's more sympathetic rather than critical.
sentences.zh: 以一种更具同情心而非批判性的方式。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I'm not saying it's magic.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说这是魔法。

sentences.en: I'm not saying it's the easiest thing to do,
sentences.zh: 我并不是说这是最容易做到的事情，

sentences.en: but I'm saying that with some effort we can get a little better at this.
sentences.zh: 但我认为通过一些努力，我们可以做得更好。

sentences.en: So your spouse is late.
sentences.zh: 所以，你的配偶迟到了。

sentences.en: Your spouse is disrespectful.
sentences.zh: 你的配偶表现得不尊重人。

sentences.en: I mean, ideally not in a huge way, but your spouse does something inconsiderate.
sentences.zh: 我是说，理想情况下不是什么大事，但你的配偶做了一些欠考虑的事情。

sentences.en: You have a lot of control over how that behavior affects you.
sentences.zh: 你对这种行为如何影响你有很大的控制权。

sentences.en: And in particular, you have control over whether you want to explain that behavior
sentences.zh: 特别是，你可以控制是否要从某种关于你配偶的、可能是稳定的性格评估角度，

sentences.en: in terms of something about your spouse that's maybe stable and a characterological assessment,
sentences.zh: 来解释这种行为，

sentences.en: like my spouse is always such a jerk.
sentences.zh: 比如“我的配偶总是这么混蛋”。

sentences.en: You can try instead to say, look, my spouse was a jerk just now,
sentences.zh: 你可以试着换个角度说，看，我的配偶刚才确实很混蛋，

sentences.en: but he's under a lot of stress at work.
sentences.zh: 但他工作压力很大。

sentences.en: Or you can think, look, he probably tried the best he could.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以想，看，他可能已经尽力了。

sentences.en: You know, there was probably some traffic or some crisis at work.
sentences.zh: 你知道，可能是有交通堵塞或者工作上出了什么危机。

sentences.en: I'm just going to let it ride.
sentences.zh: 我还是算了吧。

sentences.en: Now, I'm not saying these are easy things to do
sentences.zh: 现在，我并不是说这些事情很容易做到，

sentences.en: because we do have a default to explain other people's behaviors as elements of their character.
sentences.zh: 因为我们确实习惯于将他人的行为解释为他们性格的一部分。

sentences.en: But the fact is, and we should be better at understanding this,
sentences.zh: 但事实是，我们应该更好地理解这一点，

sentences.en: there are all sorts of things that contribute to why somebody engaged in one behavior over another behavior.
sentences.zh: 有各种各样的因素导致了某人为什么会做出某种行为而不是另一种行为。

sentences.en: And we have some control over the extent to which we interpret our partner's inconsiderate
sentences.zh: 我们可以在一定程度上控制自己，以更慷慨和友善的方式解读伴侣的欠考虑

sentences.en: or rude behavior in a way that's more generous and kind.
sentences.zh: 或粗鲁行为。

sentences.en: And the kinder approach will make us happier in the relationship,
sentences.zh: 这种更友善的方法会让我们在关系中更快乐，

sentences.en: and our partner will probably be happier too.
sentences.zh: 我们的伴侣可能也会更快乐。

sentences.en: You also think that having what you call a growth mindset is a useful thing.
sentences.zh: 你还认为拥有所谓的“成长型思维”是有益的。

sentences.en: What do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你指的是什么？

sentences.en: So the psychologist Carol Dweck at Stanford,
sentences.zh: 斯坦福大学的心理学家卡罗尔·德韦克，

sentences.en: she's developed this idea that people differ in terms of how they think about various attributes.
sentences.zh: 她提出了一个观点，即人们在看待各种属性的方式上存在差异。

sentences.en: So she studies intelligence, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，她研究智力。

sentences.en: And people differ in the extent to which they think intelligence is something that's fixed and stable
sentences.zh: 人们在认为智力是固定的、稳定的，

sentences.en: and you have it or you don't versus it's malleable and it's something that you can develop over time.
sentences.zh: 即你拥有它或者没有它，还是认为它是可塑的、可以通过时间来发展的，这些看法上存在差异。

sentences.en: Well, it turns out there's a lot of good research now on the extent to which people feel like compatibility
sentences.zh: 事实证明，现在有很多好的研究探讨了人们在多大程度上认为关系中的兼容性

sentences.en: in a relationship is something that is fixed.
sentences.zh: 是某种固定的东西。

sentences.en: You know, you could call this a destiny mindset.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可以称之为“宿命论思维”。

sentences.en: People who think, look, partners are either compatible or they're not,
sentences.zh: 那些认为“看，伴侣要么兼容，要么不兼容”，

sentences.en: and that's the end of the story, versus more of a growth-oriented mindset who think,
sentences.zh: 这就是故事的结局的人，与那些更倾向于“成长型思维”的人相比，后者认为，

sentences.en: look, there's a lot of room where you can develop compatibility.
sentences.zh: “看，有很多空间可以发展兼容性”。

sentences.en: And in fact, going through difficulties in a relationship isn't a signal that, oh, my goodness, we're incompatible people.
sentences.zh: 事实上，经历关系中的困难并不是在发出信号说“天哪，我们是不兼容的人”。

sentences.en: It's an opportunity to learn to understand each other better
sentences.zh: 这是一个学习更好地理解彼此的机会，

sentences.en: and strengthen the relationship through the resolution of the conflict.
sentences.zh: 并通过解决冲突来加强关系。

sentences.en: And here again, it's not like we have complete control over the thoughts that we have about these things,
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们同样无法完全控制自己对这些事情的想法，

sentences.en: but we can try to make ourselves adopt a more constructive, growth-oriented approach
sentences.zh: 但我们可以尝试采取一种更具建设性、以成长为导向的方法，

sentences.en: to thinking about conflict in the relationship rather than a more destiny-oriented approach
sentences.zh: 来思考关系中的冲突，而不是采取一种更倾向于宿命论的方法，

sentences.en: that can often view conflict as a deep sign of incompatibility,
sentences.zh: 因为后者往往将冲突视为不兼容的深刻标志，

sentences.en: and that's pretty destructive for the relationship.
sentences.zh: 这对关系来说是相当破坏性的。

sentences.en: You also talk about more serious alternatives.
sentences.zh: 你还谈到了更严肃的替代方案。

sentences.en: So if people find over time that they are just incompatible with one another
sentences.zh: 如果人们随着时间的推移发现他们确实彼此不兼容，

sentences.en: and yet they have these high expectations of different things they want from their life,
sentences.zh: 但他们对生活想要的东西又有着很高的期望，

sentences.en: you suggest that one of the alternatives might be to develop systems
sentences.zh: 你建议其中一种替代方案可能是建立某种系统，

sentences.en: where people are actually getting different things from different people.
sentences.zh: 让人们实际上从不同的人那里获得不同的东西。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's the same logic again, right?
sentences.zh: 这又是同样的逻辑，对吧？

sentences.en: So we have this all-or-nothing approach.
sentences.zh: 所以我们采取了这种“全有或全无”的方法。

sentences.en: We expect these high-level things,
sentences.zh: 我们期望得到这些高层次的东西，

sentences.en: and many of our marriages are, in fact, falling short of that.
sentences.zh: 而我们的许多婚姻实际上并没有达到这一点。

sentences.en: So one possibility is that we try to invest more in the relationship,
sentences.zh: 所以一种可能性是我们尝试在关系中投入更多，

sentences.en: and the second possibility, which we've called love hacks, is how to be more efficient.
sentences.zh: 第二种可能性，也就是我们所说的“爱情黑客”，是如何提高效率。

sentences.en: But the third possibility, and I actually think we should be pretty serious about this.
sentences.zh: 但第三种可能性，我实际上认为我们应该非常认真地对待它。

sentences.en: There's nothing shameful about making these sorts of sacrifices.
sentences.zh: 做出这种牺牲并没有什么可耻的。

sentences.en: We should ask less.
sentences.zh: 我们应该减少索取。

sentences.en: In what ways can we, in our own marriage, look to the relationship and see,
sentences.zh: 在我们的婚姻中，我们可以从哪些方面审视这段关系，看看，

sentences.en: man, like I have been looking to fulfill this sort of need in the relationship for a long time,
sentences.zh: 天哪，我长期以来一直试图在关系中满足这种需求，

sentences.en: and I'm chronically a little disappointed about how we do as a couple
sentences.zh: 而我对于我们作为一对伴侣在满足这种需求方面的表现，长期以来一直感到有点失望。

sentences.en: and helping to fulfill this sort of need.
sentences.zh: 有没有其他方法可以满足我的这种需求，

sentences.en: Is there some other way that I might be able to meet this need I have,
sentences.zh: 无论是通过其他朋友，还是通过我自己？

sentences.en: either through some other friends or even on my own?
sentences.zh: 西北大学的心理学家伊莱恩·钟进行了一些研究，

sentences.en: And there's some research by the psychologist Elaine Chung at Northwestern University
sentences.zh: 她研究了她所说的“社会多样化”。

sentences.en: that looks at what she calls social diversification.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你愿意的话，你能让你的社交组合多样化吗？

sentences.en: Like, can you diversify your social portfolio, if you will?
sentences.zh: 她观察了我们在感到情绪时求助的对象，

sentences.en: And she looks at the people we turn to when we're feeling emotions
sentences.zh: 那些可以帮助我们调节情绪的人。

sentences.en: that can help us regulate those emotions.
sentences.zh: 所以，当你感到悲伤时，你会向谁求助？

sentences.en: So to whom do you turn when you're feeling sad?
sentences.zh: 当你想要庆祝快乐时，你会向谁求助？

sentences.en: To whom do you turn when you want to celebrate your happiness?
sentences.zh: 她评估了人们在多大程度上依赖于相对少数的人。

sentences.en: And she assesses how much people look to a relatively small number of people
sentences.zh: （注：原文此处编号149对应内容为“And she assesses how much people look to a relatively small number of people”，已翻译）

sentences.en: to do all of those things versus a larger number of people.
sentences.zh: 去完成所有那些事情，而不是只依靠少数几个人。

sentences.en: And she finds across a range of studies now
sentences.zh: 她现在通过一系列研究发现，

sentences.en: that people who've diversified their social portfolio,
sentences.zh: 那些多元化了自己社交组合的人，

sentences.en: that is, turned to different sorts of people for different sorts of emotional experiences,
sentences.zh: 也就是说，向不同的人寻求不同类型的情感体验，

sentences.en: tend to be a little bit happier.
sentences.zh: 往往会稍微快乐一些。

sentences.en: And so with regard to marriage in particular,
sentences.zh: 因此，特别是在婚姻方面，

sentences.en: we've really lumped a lot of our emotional fulfillment on this one relationship.
sentences.zh: 我们确实把太多的情感寄托都压在了这一段关系上。

sentences.en: And for many of us, we would benefit and our marriage would actually benefit
sentences.zh: 对我们许多人来说，如果我们能在某些方面要求少一点，

sentences.en: if we asked a little bit less in some respects.
sentences.zh: 我们自己和我们的婚姻其实都会受益。

sentences.en: I love the idea of diversification and the analogy with financial diversification.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢多元化的理念，以及它与金融多元化的类比。

sentences.en: I mean, so the idea, of course, is that you might have, you know, bonds in your portfolio
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这个想法当然是，你的投资组合里可能有一些债券，

sentences.en: and they don't do very well and they don't grow a lot, but they're very stable.
sentences.zh: 它们表现平平，增长不多，但非常稳定。

sentences.en: And then you might have some stocks in your portfolio that, you know, are high growth,
sentences.zh: 然后你的投资组合里可能还有一些股票，你知道，它们增长很快，

sentences.en: but they also have the potential for losing a lot.
sentences.zh: 但同时也伴随着巨大的亏损风险。

sentences.en: And what you're suggesting is that by having different things accomplish different parts
sentences.zh: 而你的建议是，通过让不同的事物来满足你需求的不同部分，

sentences.en: of what you need, your portfolio as a whole ends up being more stable
sentences.zh: 你的整个投资组合最终会比把所有鸡蛋放在一个篮子里更稳定。

sentences.en: than if you put all your eggs in one basket.
sentences.zh: 把所有鸡蛋放在一个篮子里。

sentences.en: You know, that's right.
sentences.zh: 没错，确实如此。

sentences.en: And that's a neat way of thinking about it that I hadn't fully processed previously.
sentences.zh: 这是一种很好的思考方式，我之前还没有完全消化过。

sentences.en: In some sense, what we're doing with marriage these days is we've got a heavily stock-loaded portfolio.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，我们如今对待婚姻的方式，就像是持有一个高风险的股票投资组合。

sentences.en: And that means that when the market is up, we make huge gains.
sentences.zh: 这意味着当市场行情好时，我们会获得巨大的收益。

sentences.en: But that's a lot of eggs to put in that one basket.
sentences.zh: 但把所有的鸡蛋都放在那个篮子里风险太大了。

sentences.en: And when the market goes down, we're going to get hit pretty hard.
sentences.zh: 而当市场下跌时，我们会遭受沉重的打击。

sentences.en: And to some degree, that's also a reasonable metaphor for the self-expressive marriage,
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，这也是“自我表达型婚姻”的一个恰当隐喻，

sentences.en: where we look to one person to fulfill so many of our emotional and our psychological needs.
sentences.zh: 我们指望一个人来满足我们太多的情感和心理需求。

sentences.en: The payoff can be huge, but there's a lot of risk.
sentences.zh: 回报可能巨大，但风险也极高。

sentences.en: Now, for people to actually consider diversifying their portfolio romantically and emotionally,
sentences.zh: 那么，对于那些真正考虑在浪漫和情感上实现投资组合多元化的人来说，

sentences.en: presumably this also creates stresses on what we think of as marriage.
sentences.zh: 这大概也会给我们所认为的婚姻带来压力。

sentences.en: So if people are looking outside the marriage for emotional support or other needs,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果人们在婚姻之外寻求情感支持或其他需求，

sentences.en: some people are going to say, well, are you really married anymore?
sentences.zh: 有些人会说，好吧，你们还算是真正的夫妻吗？

sentences.en: I think this is a valid question.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个合理的问题。

sentences.en: And this is a complexity that comes up when you think about how an institution like marriage changes over time.
sentences.zh: 当你思考像婚姻这样的制度如何随时间演变时，就会出现这种复杂性。

sentences.en: I suspect that if somebody transported from 1750 to today, they might look around and say,
sentences.zh: 我怀疑，如果有人从1750年穿越到今天，他们可能会环顾四周说，

sentences.en: whoa, that doesn't look like marriage.
sentences.zh: 哇，那看起来不像婚姻。

sentences.en: I don't even really get what you guys are doing.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不太明白你们在做什么。

sentences.en: Or better yet, if we transported back to 1750 and looked at what people were expecting
sentences.zh: 或者更好的是，如果我们穿越回1750年，看看当时人们的期望，

sentences.en: and how little they were looking for personal fulfillment from the marriage, we would be bewildered.
sentences.zh: 看看他们对婚姻中个人满足感的追求有多低，我们也会感到困惑。

sentences.en: So one of the more controversial ideas that I play with in the book is when I'm talking about ways that we can ask less of the marriage.
sentences.zh: 所以，我在书中探讨的一个更具争议的想法是，我谈到了我们可以如何对婚姻少一点索求。

sentences.en: By the way, when I am doing that, I'm talking about how can we strengthen the marriage by asking less of it.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，当我这么说时，我是在谈论如何通过减少对婚姻的索求来加强婚姻。

sentences.en: One of the places that I consider is in the romantic or sexual domain.
sentences.zh: 我考虑的领域之一是浪漫或性领域。

sentences.en: So is it reasonable for some people to consider some type of consensual non-monogamy?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于某些人来说，考虑某种形式的共识性非单配偶制是否合理？

sentences.en: Now, this is not cheating.
sentences.zh: 这可不是出轨。

sentences.en: That's the whole idea of consensual non-monogamy.
sentences.zh: 这就是共识性非单配偶制的全部含义。

sentences.en: This is an understanding that we don't need to have complete monogamy all the time.
sentences.zh: 这是一种共识，即我们不需要时刻保持完全的单配偶制。

sentences.en: And you can negotiate an alternative.
sentences.zh: 你可以协商出一种替代方案。

sentences.en: In fact, among millennials, this is becoming an increasingly common way of thinking about the ideal relationship.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在千禧一代中，这正成为一种越来越普遍的理想关系思考方式。

sentences.en: So this is an ideal option, especially for people who generally are connecting pretty well and they love each other
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个理想的选择，特别是对于那些总体上相处得很好、彼此相爱，

sentences.en: and they're good co-CEOs of the household together, but they're really struggling to sustain a mutually satisfying sex life together.
sentences.zh: 并且是很好的家庭共同经营者，但却难以维持双方满意的性生活的人来说。

sentences.en: Those are particularly good opportunities to consider.
sentences.zh: 这些是特别值得考虑的机会。

sentences.en: Could we reduce some of the disappointment and pressure by opening up the relationship in some ways that we can both agree to?
sentences.zh: 我们能否通过以双方都能同意的方式开放关系，来减少一些失望和压力？

sentences.en: It's certainly a high-risk option, but it's an option that probably will benefit some relationships.
sentences.zh: 这当然是一个高风险的选择，但它很可能使一些关系受益。

sentences.en: You see that you and Allison have developed a shorthand of sorts for the times that you want to communicate affection but are starved of time.
sentences.zh: 你看到你和艾莉森已经形成了一种简写，用于那些你想表达爱意却又时间紧迫的时候。

sentences.en: And it has to do with this song.
sentences.zh: 这与这首歌有关。

sentences.en: Imagine she's a pretty nice girl, but she doesn't have a lot to say.
sentences.zh: 想象她是个很不错的女孩，但她没什么话可说。

sentences.en: Imagine she's a pretty nice girl, but she changes from day to day.
sentences.zh: 想象她是个很不错的女孩，但她每天都在变。

sentences.en: I want to tell her that I love her a lot, but I gotta get a belly full of wine.
sentences.zh: 我想告诉她我非常爱她，但我得先喝杯酒填饱肚子。

sentences.en: Imagine she's a pretty nice girl, someday I'm gonna make her mind.
sentences.zh: 想象她是个很不错的女孩，总有一天我会让她回心转意。

sentences.en: That's Paul McCartney at the end of the Abbey Road medley.
sentences.zh: 那是保罗·麦卡特尼在《艾比路》串烧曲末尾唱的。

sentences.en: It's like a little 23-second bonus track.
sentences.zh: 就像一首23秒的小彩蛋歌曲。

sentences.en: And it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: I haven't heard it in a while.
sentences.zh: 我已经很久没听过了。

sentences.en: And even as I listened to it, as you just played it, I sort of teared up a little bit
sentences.zh: 即使刚才听你播放时，我也有些热泪盈眶，

sentences.en: because it's been a very significant song for my wife and me in our marriage.
sentences.zh: 因为它对我妻子和我的婚姻来说是一首非常有意义的歌。

sentences.en: When we were first dating, you know, people are falling in love and they often say, I love you or whatever.
sentences.zh: 我们刚开始约会时，你知道，人们坠入爱河，经常会说“我爱你”之类的。

sentences.en: But I was very partial to this idea of belly full of wine, right?
sentences.zh: 但我非常偏爱“喝杯酒填饱肚子”这个说法，对吧？

sentences.en: I want to tell her that I love her a lot, but I gotta get a belly full of wine.
sentences.zh: 我想告诉她我非常爱她，但我得先喝杯酒填饱肚子。

sentences.en: And eventually saying belly full of wine was our little replacement for I love you.
sentences.zh: 最终，说“喝杯酒填饱肚子”成了我们代替“我爱你”的小暗号。

sentences.en: And what was neat about the way we used the phrase belly full of wine is it was able to contain like a whole terabyte of information about love and respect and affection in this like one second phrase.
sentences.zh: 我们使用“喝杯酒填饱肚子”这个短语的妙处在于，它能在这个一秒钟的短语中包含关于爱、尊重和深情的海量信息。

sentences.en: We could turn to each other and just say belly full of wine and just really communicate so much information in that very little, just those few words.
sentences.zh: 我们可以转向对方，只说“喝杯酒填饱肚子”，就能在那短短的几个词中传达如此多的信息。

sentences.en: And this is an example of a broader idea that we don't appreciate enough, which is that every marriage has its own culture that has its own language and its own expectations.
sentences.zh: 这是我们未能充分重视的一个更广泛理念的例子，即每段婚姻都有自己的文化，有自己的语言和期望。

sentences.en: And we can leverage the features of how culture works to benefit the marriage with a sort of emotional shorthand that can help express affection.
sentences.zh: 我们可以利用文化运作的特点，通过一种可以帮助表达爱意的情感简写来造福婚姻。

sentences.en: And it can be especially crucial if you're going through a difficult time and maybe things are getting a little hot and maybe you're on the verge of a fight and you can say, hey,
sentences.zh: 如果你们正在经历困难时期，气氛可能有点紧张，甚至处于争吵边缘，这尤其关键，你可以说，嘿，

sentences.en: baby, belly full of wine.
sentences.zh: 宝贝，喝杯酒填饱肚子。

sentences.en: And you might be able to diffuse some of what could have been a pretty problematic episode.
sentences.zh: 你或许就能化解一场本可能相当棘手的冲突。

sentences.zh: 伊莱·芬克尔是西北大学的社会心理学家。

sentences.en: He's the author of The All or Nothing Marriage, How the Best Marriages Work.
sentences.zh: 他是《全或无的婚姻：最好的婚姻是如何运作的》一书的作者。

sentences.zh: 伊莱，感谢你今天参加《隐藏的大脑》节目。

sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我。

sentences.zh: 今天的“无名英雄”环节，我们将话筒交给你们，我们的听众。

sentences.en: Our story comes from Deb Merchant.
sentences.zh: 我们的故事来自黛布·麦钱特。

sentences.en: Her unsung hero is Scott Stevens, her partner of 22 years.
sentences.zh: 她的无名英雄是斯科特·史蒂文斯，她相伴22年的伴侣。

sentences.en: In 2003, Scott and I had been dating for just a couple of years when I was diagnosed with breast cancer.
sentences.zh: 2003年，斯科特和我约会才几年，我就被诊断出患有乳腺癌。

sentences.en: And I gave him the choice to opt out of the relationship.
sentences.zh: 我给了他选择退出这段关系的机会。

sentences.en: And he didn't hesitate to say, no, we're a team.
sentences.zh: 但他毫不犹豫地说，不，我们是一个团队。

sentences.en: We're doing this together.
sentences.zh: 我们要一起面对。

sentences.en: And so we did.
sentences.zh: 于是我们做到了。

sentences.en: After biopsy and tamoxifen and radiation, the doctor said, we'll never see you again.
sentences.zh: 在活检、他莫昔芬治疗和放疗后，医生说，我们再也不会见到你了。

sentences.en: A couple of years later, however, the cancer came back, and this time it was a different matter.
sentences.zh: 然而几年后，癌症复发了，这一次情况不同了。

sentences.en: This involved many surgeries.
sentences.zh: 这涉及多次手术。

sentences.en: And in January 2007, I started six months of chemotherapy.
sentences.zh: 2007年1月，我开始了为期六个月的化疗。

sentences.en: Our first visit, there were 10 or 12 of us all receiving chemotherapy that day.
sentences.zh: 第一次去的时候，我们那天有10到12个人在接受化疗。

sentences.en: As we looked through the windows out towards the Cascade Mountains.
sentences.zh: 当我们透过窗户望向喀斯喀特山脉时。

sentences.en: I thought for sure that Scott would drop me off, head back to his office to continue his work, and come pick me up at the end of the day.
sentences.zh: 我原以为斯科特会把我放下，回办公室继续工作，然后在一天结束时来接我。

sentences.en: And instead, he stayed with me all day.
sentences.zh: 但相反，他整天都陪着我。

sentences.en: He got me through being comfortable in a chair with the right pillow and warm blanket, making sure I had the right food and tea.
sentences.zh: 他帮我调整好椅子，放好合适的枕头和暖和的毯子，确保我有合适的食物和茶，让我感到舒适。

sentences.en: And then he went to the next person and asked them, are you comfortable?
sentences.zh: 然后他走到下一个人身边问他们，你舒服吗？

sentences.en: Can I get you anything?
sentences.zh: 我能为你做点什么吗？

sentences.en: Would you like a warm blanket or pillow?
sentences.zh: 你需要暖和的毯子或枕头吗？

sentences.en: How about some hot tea?
sentences.zh: 来点热茶怎么样？

sentences.en: And then he went to the next person, and the next person, and the next person.
sentences.zh: 然后他又走到下一个人、下一个人、再下一个人身边。

sentences.en: And I thought maybe the first day, that that would be it.
sentences.zh: 我以为可能第一天会这样而已。

sentences.en: But he stuck with me every single week through chemotherapy.
sentences.zh: 但他整个化疗期间，每周都坚持陪着我。

sentences.en: And he went to every single person in every single chair every single week throughout that entire period.
sentences.zh: 在那整个期间，他每周都去照顾每一个坐在椅子上的人。

sentences.en: Scott's care and love of people comes firSt.
sentences.zh: 斯科特对人的关怀和爱心是第一位的。

sentences.en: He's actually said to me, I'll take love over money any day.
sentences.zh: 他甚至对我说过，我随时都会选择爱而不是金钱。

sentences.en: And he demonstrated that during our time when we went through chemotherapy together.
sentences.zh: 在我们一起经历化疗的那段时间里，他证明了这一点。

sentences.en: And because of him, I'm doing great today.
sentences.zh: 因为他，我今天过得很好。

sentences.en: It's his commitment to be present for someone he loves that made a huge difference in my life.
sentences.zh: 正是他那种为所爱之人时刻陪伴的承诺，让我的生活发生了巨大的改变。

sentences.en: And that's why he's my unsung hero.
sentences.zh: 这就是他成为我无名英雄的原因。

sentences.en: Deb Merchant and Scott Stevens live in Albany, Oregon.
sentences.zh: 黛布·麦钱特和斯科特·史蒂文斯住在俄勒冈州的奥尔巴尼。

sentences.en: In their spare time, they love to hike, snowshoe, and camp in the Cascade Mountains.
sentences.zh: 闲暇时，他们喜欢在喀斯喀特山脉徒步、穿雪鞋行走和露营。

sentences.en: Deb has been cancer-free for the last 13 years.
sentences.zh: 黛布在过去13年里一直没有癌症复发。

sentences.zh: 请访问 support.hiddenbrain.org。
